metadata.description: Personal, portable toolkit of reusable Claude systems: skills, rules, hooks, and templates shared across every project and device.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Four skills: project-init sets up new projects; project-sync audits existing projects; work-item-lifecycle applies the project's file lifecycle when information is created, moved, organized, or completed; and machine-sync sets up Claude and Codex machine-wide instructions, settings, and hooks.

plugins.name: sf-architect-solutioning
plugins.description: Salesforce solution architect skill: pushes back on vague requirements, verifies platform facts against official Salesforce docs (live fetch, never memory), designs declarative-first to Well-Architected standards, and produces an approved solution plan before any build.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Portable Git-native project knowledge for Claude, Codex, and optional Obsidian. One managed operating manual, a small shared startup map, flat memory, visible provenance, project-scoped owner-approved saves, task-specific skills, read-only session search, and one checker.

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Three parallel-session-safe git lifecycle skills. pull-latest updates without rewriting history, reset-to-remote mirrors a remote behind explicit confirmation, and merge-and-clean-up lands an approved pull request before safely removing only its branch and worktree.

plugins.name: hooks-library
plugins.description: Hooks that make a rule land mechanically instead of restating it. no-ai-attribution-guard refuses any commit or pull request whose text credits an AI, on every repository on the machine. spec-check-reminder asks once, at the session's first file edit, whether the spec-check review has run, so building from a drifted specification is caught at the moment it starts. work-item-stage-reminder asks once per session which work item this is, what stage it is at, and whether its progress log is current. Two Salesforce guards protect production deploys and permission-set deploys.

plugins.name: work-tracker
plugins.description: Local work tracking shared by Claude and Codex, with flat Git-ignored .work-items folders, YAML records, owner-approved requirements, deterministic status, handoffs, relationships, Git landing verification, generated dashboards, and preview-first conversion of older staged trackers.

plugins.name: session-skills
plugins.description: Eight skills for working inside one conversation. braindump plays back a pasted brain dump in very simple words and waits for the owner's yes before any work starts. explain-simply says the last answer again as plain bullets without losing a number, date, path, or name. grill-me interviews the owner one question at a time and checkpoints every answer to a persistent file before continuing. handoff runs the short persistent-information review, then drafts a prompt a fresh session can start from, opening with the goal and checked by a second agent that never saw the conversation. session-summary tables what the owner asked for and gives each request an honest status. track-tasks keeps every still-open topic on Claude Code's built-in task list, including parked topics, unanswered questions, and blocked work. spec-check reads the specification an agent is about to build from or design a solution from, flags anything that could skew the work, and proposes fixes the owner approves before building starts. unslop takes writing that already exists, names every pattern in it that reads as machine-written, and hands back a version with those patterns gone and a voice put back, writing to a file only on the owner's yes.
